snapshot.instruction: When Jeff asks what workers, lanes, jobs, or services are doing, answer from this snapshot in short plain English: say what is moving, the worker/model, and elapsed time from work. Live process observations in work include lane screens and workers outside the queue. Running means a live worker process, not proof of forward progress or completion. An unverified screen has no confirmed worker; a claimed entry is only a queue record. Missing model or elapsed time is unknown; do not invent it. Hide internal IDs, screen names, history and raw fields unless Jeff asks for those details. Never print None. Queue counts include all jobs; lists show recent examples. Done/failed jobs are history, not active work. Lane lock reports are cached at checked_at; current queue claims and screen presence take precedence. active_jobs only covers journaled queue claims. Background work may hold a busy lane without a claim; an empty active_jobs list does not prove an idle or stale lock. Report unidentified work as unknown, and do not infer that all workers are idle from an empty queue. Do not tell Jeff to use special job syntax. Do not say you cannot see workers if this block lists them. Chat provider health comes only from provider_health, not old messages or lane locks. A successful probe checks configuration; last_success proves generation. A past failure followed by success is recovered, not a current outage.
